module.summary: GC-safe parent/child reference links built on newproxy proxies: weak links (child to parent) and hard links (parent to child).

MakeWeakLink.desc: Creates (or reuses wlink as) a weak proxy for obj and records it in obj._wlinks, so a child's reference to its parent does not block GC.

MakeHardLink.desc: Creates a hard-link proxy and records it in obj._hlinks; its __gc calls obj:AutoDispose() once no other hard link remains.

UnlinkSafe.desc: Calls userdata links repeatedly until the real object is reached; non-link values are returned unchanged.

CompareLinks.desc: Unlinks both sides first, then tells whether two links point to the same object.

CheckWeakLink.desc: Returns the target when link is a userdata proxy whose target is still alive, otherwise false.

fileDesc: Creates weak/hard proxy links between parent and child objects to break reference cycles that would block GC.
